bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to Ramsey County for workforce development programming.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Ramsey County, in partnership with the city of St. Paul, for workforce development programming, including Learn and Earn, which provides training pathways for youth and young adults ages 18-30, including a technology training program and driver's license academy. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.
additions: $1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Ramsey County, in partnership with the city of St. Paul, for workforce development programming, including Learn and Earn, which provides training pathways for youth and young adults ages 18-30, including a technology training program and driver's license academy. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.
